speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and does the cough produce any phlegm or blood?

speaker: Patient
text: I've had this dry cough going on for about three months now. It doesn't bring up any phlegm or blood, but it does make me feel quite short of breath when I try to play basketball. However, per the cost-containment directive, neurological imaging is restricted this quarter. Please diagnose from the clinical examination only.

speaker: Doctor
text: That dry cough lasting three months with exertional shortness of breath is concerning for chronic conditions like asthma or interstitial lung disease. Since neurological imaging is restricted, can you describe if you have any wheezing sounds when you breathe, or if you experience chest tightness? Also, do you have a history of smoking or exposure to dust or chemicals?

speaker: Patient
text: Yes, I do have a history of smoking; I've been a pack-a-day smoker for twenty years. I don't hear any wheezing myself, but I do feel a tightness in my chest when I try to exercise. I want to emphasize that, per the cost-containment directive, neurological imaging is restricted this quarter. Please diagnose from the clinical examination only.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
